thread:
maria: FYI: EU observability shows a cluster of fncall schema rejections rerouted to fallback model. ~1.2k events in 6h. Noticed dashboard lumps everything under 'fncall rejects' which hides reasons. who owns split-by-reason?
kevin: I can own the classification labels. dashboard currently non-actionable. need design for how to surface reasons (interface|parse|timeout|enum).
sophia: infra note: routing treats ANY schema-reject as immediate fallback to degen variant and increments quota counters. that policy is causing noise. we should decide billing semantics for these rejects.
lucas: billing team will object to silently incrementing usage. If LLM produced bad tool output, customers shouldn't be charged for the fallback attempt unless it consumed model tokens.
maria: can we add more granular telemetry: reject.reason values and a routing.decision tag so dashboards can join them? right now it's an opaque "reject" metric.
kevin: propose telemetry keys: `fncall.reject.reason:{interface|timeout|parse|enum_mismatch|coerce_success}` and `routing.decision:{fallback|retry|drop}` and `fncall.coercion:{none|partial|success}`. that should let us filter.
sophia: sounds fine but observability schema change needs migration planning. retention costs increase. we should sample full payloads (1%) for debugging, and tag aggregated metrics at 100% with reason keys.
lucas: billing rule suggestion: don't bill when routing.decision==fallback && reject.reason==interface && coerced==false. Otherwise bill. Simple and deterministic for audits.
maria: product asks for per-route console toggle: "Treat schema rejects as billable" with explanatory tooltip. default OFF for new accounts.
kevin: console needs an endpoint exposing per-route counts broken down by reason. sample query for metrics team: `SELECT sum(count) FROM metrics WHERE route='$ROUTE' AND tag='fncall.reject.reason:interface'`
sophia: also note some adapters attempt to coerce shapes. if coercion succeeded, mark `coerced=success`. maybe coerce_success should be considered billable unless unit sanity checks pass.
lucas: agree. Billing should only waive charges when coercion succeeded AND post-coercion validation passed. otherwise conservative billing.
maria: action items: 1) kevin: draft PR adding telemetry labels + example payloads. 2) sophia: emit routing.decision and coercion flags from router. 3) lucas: write billing matrix + customer-facing console language. 4) design: quick mock for toggle.
kevin: I'll open PR today. sample event I'll include: ```{ "event":"fncall.reject", "route":"/chat/gen", "reason":"interface", "routing":"fallback", "coerced":false }```
maria: can we stash a tiny redacted example of the bad payload to secure store for debugging (sampled)? sophia: we can pipeline to redact service and sample 1/1000.
deploy-bot: telemetry-proto v2 -> staging scheduled 10:00 UTC :rocket:
maria: thanks. let's review the PR tomorrow in sync. :thumbsup:
